bio.name: Joseph Blumberg
bio.claim: I build systems that run themselves.
bio.intro: I study economics and computational and applied math at the University of Chicago, class of 2029. Everything I build runs through one Obsidian brain: my agents read it first and commit what they learn back to it.
bio.offBoard: Off the board: guitar (16 years), bouldering (V8 at my peak), 80+ board games, 400+ records and CDs, 1750 on Chess.com.
